Campaign Pulse

What Each Platform Delivers

Instagram

Reach-per-post leader. 298 Reels averaged 993 views each — the most efficient platform for view delivery with 2.7K likes on top. (Share data not exposed by Instagram's API.)

Youtube

Steady long-tail reach. 261 Shorts delivered 66K views and 1.1K likes — lower volume but persistent discovery. (YouTube's public API does not return share counts.)

Tiktok
Top Total ViewsTop LikesTop SharesTop Avg Views/PostTop Engagement Rate

Volume and virality engine. 206 submissions driving 378K views, 15K likes, and 181 shares — the only platform in this campaign where share data is publicly available, so it's the clearest window into true organic spread.

Key Takeaways

01

Strong Multi-Platform Presence

765 unique submissions distributed across 3 major platforms demonstrate broad creator engagement and campaign reach.

02

Instagram Dominates Volume

Instagram leads with 298 submissions (39.0%), confirming it as the primary content creation platform for this campaign.

03

740K+ Total Reach

739,690 total views averaging ~967 per submission. Tiktok drove the highest view counts despite fewer submissions.

04

Tiktok View Power

206 Tiktok submissions generated 378K views — 51.1% of all views — showing massive per-post engagement on the platform.
